nodes.summary: Homotopy groups, singular homology and other algebraic invariants of spaces, with classical theorems such as Borsuk–Ulam, Hurewicz and Hopf invariant one.
nodes.title: Algebraic topology

nodes.summary: Compact connected spaces, Peano continua and space-filling curves, absolute retracts, hyperspaces, the Hilbert cube and fixed-point properties.
nodes.title: Continuum theory and infinite-dimensional topology

nodes.summary: The topology of Polish spaces and their definable subsets: classical characterizations of Cantor space, Baire space and the rationals, Borel complexity, Bernstein sets and topological games.
nodes.title: Descriptive set theory

nodes.summary: Point-set topology of topological and metric spaces: connectedness, separation and cardinal invariants, homogeneous spaces, direct and inverse limits of spaces, restricted products, and dimension theory.
nodes.title: General topology

nodes.summary: Embeddings of circles in three-space up to ambient isotopy: knot and link diagrams, chirality, slice knots, and geometric invariants such as ropelength, distortion and quadrisecants.
nodes.title: Knot theory

nodes.summary: Topological and smooth manifolds in low and high dimensions: surfaces, 3- and 4-manifolds, the Poincaré conjecture, exotic spheres, triangulations, diffeomorphism groups and transformation groups.
nodes.title: Manifolds and geometric topology

nodes.summary: Groups carrying a compatible topology: metrizability, profinite groups and profinite completions, and functions on locally compact groups.
nodes.title: Topological groups

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
